# Obsidian Agent Memory

## Routes

- Initialize a memory root: `obsidian-agent-memory-init`.
- Resolve session context: `obsidian-agent-memory-route`.
- Coordinate durable work: `obsidian-agent-memory-collaboration`.
- Query durable facts: `obsidian-agent-memory-query`.
- Add one durable fact: `obsidian-agent-memory-add`.
- Summarize a session: `obsidian-agent-memory-summary`.
- Maintain memory state: `obsidian-agent-memory-maintain`.
- Upgrade memory schema: `obsidian-agent-memory-upgrade`.
